title: google-labs-code/stitch-skills
lede: stitch-skills packages agent skills for Google's Stitch design tool, so coding agents can generate screens, extract design systems and turn designs into React code through the Stitch MCP server.

points: Ships three plugins: stitch-design for creating and editing screens, stitch-build for code generation, and stitch-utilities for prompts and DESIGN.md files.
Skills cover converting existing frontend code into a Stitch design, pulling a DESIGN.md out of source, and turning screens into React or React Native components.
Follows the Agent Skills standard, so the folders load in Codex, Claude Code, Cursor, Gemini CLI and Antigravity; OpenCode needs a manual copy.
Every skill depends on a configured Stitch MCP server with its own credentials.

points.text: Screen download links now redirect to Google sign-in, breaking MCP clients that authenticate with an API key.
Users want a Vue skill alongside the React targets.
The design-system uploader only works when run from a repo checkout.
